namespace PubAC13
structure Mat2 where
  a : Int
  b : Int
  c : Int
  d : Int
def det2 (M : Mat2) : Int := M.a * M.d - M.b * M.c
def mul2 (X Y : Mat2) : Mat2 :=
  ⟨X.a * Y.a + X.b * Y.c, X.a * Y.b + X.b * Y.d, X.c * Y.a + X.d * Y.c, X.c * Y.b + X.d * Y.d⟩
theorem det2_id : det2 ⟨1, 0, 0, 1⟩ = 1 := by sorry
theorem det2_mul (u v p q : Int) : det2 (mul2 ⟨u, 0, 0, v⟩ ⟨p, 0, 0, q⟩) = det2 ⟨u, 0, 0, v⟩ * det2 ⟨p, 0, 0, q⟩ := by sorry
end PubAC13
